title: Water Shutoff — North Area — Jun 11
_full_body: If you would like to respond to this notification, please place your response above the dotted line. A contractor working on behalf of a homeowner has inadvertently struck a water line in the north section of the community. An emergency water shutoff is required to facilitate repairs. The contractor is currently coordinating to have a qualified technician dispatched to the site. We are making every effort to minimize the duration of this service interruption. Additional information regarding the expected timeline and service restoration will be provided as it becomes available. We appreciate your patience and understanding during this emergency repair. Sincerely, Resource Property Management, Inc. on behalf of Home Owners of Palm Hill, Inc (727) 581-2662 | www.resourcepropertymgmt.com
